test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 10
subject: general
question: Which of the following is ***not ***among the initiatives launched during the National Urban Conclave 2025, inaugurated by Union Minister Shri Manohar Lal at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi?

options.text: Swachh Bharat Mission – Knowledge Management Unit (KMU)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Smart City Digital Twin Mission (SCDTM).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **National Urban Conclave 2025** was inaugurated by **Union Minister for Housing and Urban Affairs Shri Manohar Lal** at **Yashobhoomi, New Delhi**.
 
• The conclave, held under the theme **“Sustainable Urban Development and Governance”**, brought together over 2,500 participants including policymakers, planners, and experts.
 
• Several major national urban initiatives were launched to accelerate India’s transition toward **cleaner, smarter, and more sustainable cities**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Initiatives Launched During the Conclave:**

 
 
• **Dumpsite Remediation Accelerator Programme (DRAP):** A year-long, mission-mode initiative to fast-track the remediation of dumpsites and achieve **“Lakshya Zero Dumpsites”** by **September 2026**.
 
• **Swachh Bharat Mission – Knowledge Management Unit (KMU):** Set up at **NIUA** to serve as a national platform for **capacity building** and **knowledge management** under SBM–Urban.
 
• **Urban Invest Window (UiWIN):** An investment facilitation platform of **HUDCO** under MoHUA to attract private and multilateral funding for urban projects.
 
• **‘Jal Hi Janani’ Anthem:** Launched under the **AMRUT Mission** to highlight the importance of water conservation and sustainable urban water use.
 
 
 
• **Not Launched:** The Smart City Digital Twin Mission (SCDTM)__ was **not among the initiatives launched** during the Conclave. It is not mentioned in the official list of programmes unveiled at the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About DRAP (Dumpsite Remediation Accelerator Programme)**__

 __
 
• Prioritises **214 high-impact sites** across **202 Urban Local Bodies (ULBs)** holding 80% of India’s legacy waste.
 
• Targets the processing of **8.8 crore MT of legacy waste** and the reclamation of urban land for community use.
 
• Financial assistance: ₹550 per tonne for remediation, with ₹4,181 crore of Central Financial Assistance (CFA) sanctioned.
 
 
 
• **About UiWIN (Urban Invest Window)**__
 __
 
• Developed by **HUDCO** under MoHUA to promote **PPP-based investments** and attract funds from institutions like the **World Bank** and **ADB**.
 
• Acts as a one-stop platform for **urban infrastructure financing** and investment facilitation.
 
 
 
• **About KMU (Knowledge Management Unit)**__
 __
 
• Set up at the **National Institute of Urban Affairs (NIUA)** to strengthen institutional learning within **Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban**.
 
• Focuses on research, training, and best-practice dissemination for city-level capacity building.
 
 
 
• **Theme and Objective of the Conclave**__
 __
 
• Theme: **“Sustainable Urban Development and Governance.”**
 
• Objective: To promote coordinated urban planning, innovation, and sustainable infrastructure under the vision of **Viksit Bharat @2047**.
 
• Served as an inaugural national platform for dialogue and collaboration under **Team Urban for Viksit Bharat**.
 
 
 
• **Significance**__
 
 
• The conclave reaffirms India’s focus on **sustainability, inclusivity, and innovation** in urban development.
 
• Supports holistic growth of cities through **smart planning, waste management, and financing reforms**.
 
• Marks a major step in achieving India’s **Urban Agenda 2047** aligned with the national development goals.
